card.title: Try It First
card.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taste this cheap coffee substitute before I fill my cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If you like this, we can save the proper stuff for guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not sacrificing breakfast to save you money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sip. If it's awful, I'll buy you a croissant and keep my cup empty.

relationship.evidence: B2 names a safe alternative and B4 refuses to absorb the trial's cost for A.

heightening.evidence: B4 objection makes A5 pay for the experiment without accepting the first exposure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 empty cup makes the asymmetry of the bargain explicit and earned.
